description:
Modal dialog components. Today they're rendered via
`render_dialog_overlay/3` in Interactive — a switch statement
matching on dialog type. Under VDom they become regular components
mounted at the screen root when active; the overlay switch
disappears.

Each dialog uses `use_key` for keyboard handling and emits its own
`%VCursor{}` if it owns input focus (last-paint-wins gives correct
behaviour without explicit focus arbitration).

Acceptance: dialog_test.exs stays green; visual smoke test in tmux
confirms positioning and key handling unchanged.
title: Convert dialogs: LoginDialog + SummarizePrompt
